title: Publish provider-slot release on the scheduler root
description: Prerequisite for the daemon's atomic attempt/lease/provider-slot release composition. Hard-depend on task-9f51def13fb1484482bcb6d68ce3708d. The pure authority already exists and is QA-approved: `releaseProviderSlot` and `ProviderSlotReleaseCommand` are re-exported by `authority/lease-resource.ts`, but current `@moe/scheduler` root has zero `releaseProviderSlot` export, so a daemon consumer would have to deep-import a package-private module. Publish only this existing transition from the focused scheduler execution surface and ratchet the root namespace. Consumer: the daemon release-state composition task created immediately after this task, then task-e62e3828df234c66969a99b8223487f4.
definitionOfDone: `@moe/scheduler` publicly exports the existing `releaseProviderSlot` value and `ProviderSlotReleaseCommand` type from their owning module; no duplicate transition or vocabulary is introduced.

The hand-written runtime root roster adds exactly the one new function in reviewed order, updates the explicit count, and pins its defined function binding while retaining exact namespace equality/freeze checks.

The daemon manifest declares `@moe/scheduler`, the lock importer links it, and a temporary compiled probe inside apps/daemon imports and calls `releaseProviderSlot` plus its type from the bare specifier, typechecks exit 0, and is deleted in the same guarded command.
A mutation removing the production root export reddens the named root-roster/probe assertion rather than only a helper; restoring it returns the suite green.
`pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test` run separately with a nonzero test-count line and no owned-path regression.
taskRails: Hard-depend on task-9f51def13fb1484482bcb6d68ce3708d; own only its focused scheduler execution-surface TypeScript file and packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts.
Public-surface slice only: do not edit provider-slot-release.ts, lease-resource.ts, daemon composition, package manifests, lockfile, RuntimeCommandKind or schemas.
Use the existing public transition and exact root roster; explicit owned-path commit.
